string.text: Quest Item Tooltip 1.0.2 by Expand. Shows in the item tooltip which of your active tasks wants this item, how many, and on which map the task giver is.
Adds the "Needed for tasks" block to item tooltips. Turn off to hide it completely.
Shows the name of the person who wants the item (or the person to deliver it to).
Shows the map where that person is now, e.g. Cordon. Only the map name, not the exact place.
Also shows the task title as it appears in the PDA. Makes the tooltip longer.
Counts how many of this item you carry (green = enough, yellow = some, red = none). Items in stashes are not counted.
Some tasks with several items also pay for optional extra items. Shows those too, marked as optional.
For packages from delivery tasks, shows whom to deliver them to and on which map.

For "Crafting Info in Tooltips" with item icons on: puts the "Used for crafting / cooking" captions above their icons and keeps the icons inside the tooltip (in a column next to the stats when the tooltip is too tall for the screen). No effect without that mod.
Writes lines tagged [QuestItemTooltip] to the game log. Only for bug reports.
